Iconic trash talk moment between Kobe Bryant and Allen Iverson (2001)

Allen Iverson and Kobe Bryant did not have a personal feud, but they engaged in a fierce, respectful rivalry defined by their legendary 2001 NBA Finals clash. There was a well-known, humorous dinner story about “Kobe” (beef) rather than personal beef: early in their careers, they went out to eat in LA. Kobe immediately left the dinner to go practice, while Iverson headed to the club.
